title: Triana Tapas
text: We had a fantastic time with Nico! He knows Triana inside and out, and gave us great cultural insights into Triana, Seville and Spain from Cadiz honey to light fluffy batter made with fish bones to flamenco to what it’s like to live and work in Spain all while showing us hidden gems in Triana. To date, this is the best and most interesting tour I’ve had in Spain because Nico showed us the day to day life and culture that went beyond being a tourist. The time spent with him was authentic and genuine and we truly felt that we were ‘not just a tourist’.
author: lucymY9164WW

title: Experiencing flamenco in its birthplace with Nico was the best!
text: Our night with Nico was truly special! We had no idea that our guide was going to be an actual flamenco dancer. Experiencing the performance and learning about the art of flamenco with him was such a unique experience. Having been born and raised in Triana, he took us to amazing local spots before and after the performance. It made our last night in Seville so special.
author: flowkal123

title: Absolutely the best!
text: We spent the evening with Constanza and I can honestly say it was one of the best evenings. It was genuinely like spending the evening with an old friend that you had known for years. We had the best time and cannot recommend this highly enough. The flamenco dancing was off the scale. If you want to see an authentic show book this!!!
author: francesNotts

title: Unique, fun, informative & memorable experience!
text: Even though there was a scheduling mix up in the beginning of the tour, Mahsa was very quick & helpful to resolve the issue and we had a lovely evening!  Our tour guide Maria is warm, friendly & is a Flamenco dancer herself.  It was wonderful to talk to her before and after the show to learn about her culture and the history behind Flamenco.  It was fascinating!  The show was lovely, the tapas were delicious & it was fun to go to local non-touristy tapas bars with Maria.  It was a very memorable experience!
author: Jennifer A

title: Great night in Triana with Costanza!
text: My wife and I had an incredible tour of Triana with Costanza! We really could not have asked for a better guide. She walked us effortlessly through the city with great tapas and conversation. We were thrilled to learn she dances Flamenco and could tie the art to the culture and significance to the neighboorhood. It felt less like a tour and more like engaging in the local culture. Thank you Costanza!
author: D5703INdavidp

title: Fantastic Flamenco and Tapas night.
text: We truly enjoyed our night out with Costanza in the Tirana neighborhood of Sevilla. She is very knowledgeable and engaging with all tour participants. The tapas and Flamenco show were amazing and I recommend asking for her. She is a Flamenco dancer herself and was able to give a personal view of the art of Flamenco dancing. The Flamenco was intimate and entertaining.
author: Royh1965

title: Flamenco Experience in Seville
text: Our group of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our tapas tour and Flamenco show with Maria. The food was great, the show was intimate and  engaging, and Maria was knowledgeable and passionate. Our group added a one hour Flamenco dance lesson with Costanza before our tour/show. I highly recommend adding this lesson as it was so much fun and gave us insight into how difficult this dance is! Fun, informative and delicious night in Seville!
author: Roam727103

title: Costanza is the best!
text: We had a wonderful evening, really enjoyed this tour and Costanza was absolutely lovely! We enjoyed learning more about the Triana region, and flamenco! Thank you Costanza, until we meet again!
author: aleentiffany

title: Food, Wine, History, Flamenco!
text:
We had a fantastic time exploring the Triana neighborhood through this flamenco and tapas tour! Our guide Costanza (a flamenco dancer herself!) was absolutely amazing, walking us through the history and art of flamenco. The hour-long flamenco show was at a very intimate and historic tablao with extremely talented dancers & guitarists.

Afterward Costanza took us to a couple of historic spots with great wine and food. After 10 days in Spain, we finally felt like we got a real tapas experience with Costanza’s expert guidance!  Highly recommend this company and experience!
author: S2342TRkevinf

title: Fun night in Triana with Costanza!
text: Our family group of 5 adults had an amazing night with Costanza on the Tapas and Flamenco tour! We all agreed it was one of favorite experiences during our 10 day trip through Andalusia. Costanza is adorable and extremely personable. She kept everyone involved during the night. Her English is excellent and she made it possible for us non-Spanish speakers to enjoy Triana like a local. Highly recommend!
author: robinsonamy
